name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-bombshell-koopa
title: Redrawn Styled Bombshell Koopa
description:
Custom graphics for Erik's Better Bomb Koopa custom sprite, meant to be used alongside Icegoom's redrawn graphics.

Comes in 3 variations: classic; modern w/normal shoes; and modern w/black shoes. Also, it includes a custom palette E which the sprite uses by default.

Give credit to me and SF - The Dark Warrior if used, as it's always appreciated.
